items.question: A household used 25 kℓ of water in February 2024 (exact band boundary). Calculate the total charge (excluding VAT).

items.question: In February 2024, a household's water bill (excluding VAT) was R166,80. What was their monthly consumption in kℓ?
workingSteps: First 6 kℓ free, so the R166,80 must come entirely from the 6-25 kℓ band.
Extra kℓ at R27,80 each: R166,80 ÷ R27,80 = 6 kℓ.

items.question: A household used some electricity in March. The bill, INCLUDING 15% VAT, is R903,00. How many kWh did they use? (Hint: check whether usage is below or above 350 kWh first.)
workingSteps: R785,22 > R735, so usage exceeds 350 kWh.
Excess cost above the first block: R785,22 − R735 = R50,22.
Total kWh ≈ 350 + 15 = 365 kWh (round to nearest whole — context-dependent). Acceptable range 364-366.

items.question: A user's bill is R410,00. They made 100 minutes of local calls. How many minutes of national calls did they make?
workingSteps: Subtract rental and local calls: R410 − R250 − (100 × R0,55) = R410 − R250 − R55 = R105.

_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_TARIFF_BLOCK_FLAT: Treats a stepped/block tariff as a single flat rate applied to all consumption
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_TARIFF_BAND_BOUNDARY: Confuses which side of a band boundary a value falls on
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_TARIFF_VAT_DOUBLE_APPLIED: Adds VAT to a total that already includes VAT (or vice versa for VAT exclusion)
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_TARIFF_SUBSCRIPTION_FORGOTTEN: Omits a fixed monthly subscription or line rental when totalling a usage-based tariff
